sources.payments: Statistics Canada Table 32-10-0106-01, direct payments to agriculture producers, thousands of nominal dollars, calendar year
sources.yields: Observed crop yields by Census Agricultural Region, 1987-2025, detrended log-linearly per region and crop
sources.weather: NASA POWER monthly (MERRA-2/CERES), May-Aug, anomaly vs 1991-2020, cropland-area-weighted across ecodistricts in each province
sources.enso: NOAA Oceanic Nino Index, DJF preceding the growing season

method.payment_window: pay.*_2y adds calendar year t and t+1: crop-year claims are largely paid the following calendar year
method.dollars: nominal thousands of dollars, not deflated; *_anom fields are % deviation from each province own log-linear trend
caveats: n = 19 years (2007-2025); ENSO phase gives 7-8 years per phase
AgriStability is margin-based, not yield-based, and does not track yield

ON and PE respond proportionally to yield but have no usable DOLLAR relationship: their payment totals are dominated by programmes unrelated to field-crop yield, so sensitivity_m_per_yield_point is not meaningful there
insured liability has roughly doubled since 2014, so nominal levels drift up
